lines.speaker: John
lines.text: You ever just stand somewhere and forget why you walked over here?

lines.speaker: John
lines.text: Yeah. I think I was supposed to submit something.

lines.speaker: John
lines.text: Eh, if it was important, someone would've yelled at me by now.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: That's… a dangerously relaxed way to live.
